描述_EN: when the teddy bear craze took off in the states in 1906, the soft toys became commonly known as teddy bears. his refusal to shoot a captured bear cub in november 1902 was made famous through a political cartoon by clifford berryman in the washington post newspaper. the teddy bear gets its name from theodore ‘teddy’ roosevelt, president of the united states. the endearing cartoon bear became associated with the president. this bear was produced as a special edition for the charity, good bears of the world, and marks the centenary of president roosevelt’s association with the teddy bear.
描述_ZN: 1906年，当泰迪熊的热潮在美国掀起时，这种软体玩具被普遍称为泰迪熊。 他在1902年11月拒绝射杀一只被捕获的小熊，通过Clifford Berryman在Washington Post报纸上的一幅政治漫画而成名。 泰迪熊的名字来自美国总统Theodore 'Teddy' Roosevelt。 这只可爱的卡通熊开始与总统联系在一起。 这只熊是为慈善机构Good bears of the world制作的特别版，标志着罗斯福总统与泰迪熊的关系达到了百年。
